author: NPR Music
description:
Do you know an independent artists who deserves a bigger platform? Now is their time to shine. 

The Tiny Desk Contest is NOW OPEN for 2026! 

Here's how to enter:
1. Create a video of you performing an original song behind a desk.
2. Upload your video to YouTube.
3. Submit at npr.org/tinydeskcontest by 11:59 p.m. ET on Feb. 9, 2026.

The 2026 Tiny Desk Contest is presented by @capitalone and supported by @rivianofficial.

Hosts: @ djcuzzinb •  Bobby Carter/NPR⁠, @ anamaria.sayre • Anamaria Sayre/NPR

Producer: @ kara_frame • Kara Frame/NPR
title: The Tiny Desk Contest is NOW OPEN for 2026!
